convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for RSIOMA_V2 indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution. Custom indicator with multiple buffer reads makes auto-conversion impossible without reimplementing the indicator.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation

long.detail: Hist[1]>MainTrendLong AND Hist[0]<=MainTrendLong on previous bar crossover through upper level
Hist[1]<Hist[2] (falling) AND Hist[0]>Hist[1] (now rising) - direction change from down to up
Up[1]>Dn[1] AND Up[0]<=Dn[0] - cloud color changes from bearish to bullish

short.detail: Hist[1]<MainTrendShort AND Hist[0]>=MainTrendShort on previous bar crossover through lower level
Hist[1]>Hist[2] (rising) AND Hist[0]<Hist[1] (now falling) - direction change from up to down
Up[1]<Dn[1] AND Up[0]>=Dn[0] - cloud color changes from bullish to bearish

other_exits: BuyPosClose triggered when short entry signal fires (in breakdown mode: Hist[1]<MainTrendShort triggers BUY_Close)
SellPosClose triggered when long entry signal fires (in breakdown mode: Hist[1]>MainTrendLong triggers SELL_Close)
Opposite position closure is gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM values interpreted as fixed lot size (-0.1 = 0.1 lots). Positive MM values interpreted as deposit fraction percentage. MMMode (LOT, PCT, PRC) determines calculation method when MM is positive.

custom_logic_notes: Three selectable entry modes via AlgMode enum: 'breakdown' (histogram crosses trigger levels 60/40), 'twist' (histogram direction reversal), 'cloudtwist' (Up/Dn cloud crossover). Signal uses SignalBar offset (default=1, previous bar). Recount flag forces recalculation on first tick. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans independently gate each action. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles all order execution including BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose - actual position checking is inside those functions. GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement RSIOMA_V2 indicator logic: RSI of a moving average (RSIOMA) with configurable smoothing (JJMA/VIDIA/AMA/EMA support from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh), plus a signal MA of RSIOMA (MARSIOMA), and momentum. Buffers: 0=Up cloud, 1=Dn cloud, 4=histogram. TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be reimplemented for position sizing (conditional lot/fraction logic), order placement with SL/TP, position existence checks, and global variable cleanup. Entry logic has three modes that must all be implemented. No digit adjustment detected - SL/TP values passed directly to trade functions.
